from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper found in the document collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other provided papers that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitation] = Field(description="A list of all papers parsed from the documents")
